taskManager.recoveryFile:
Argus Task Manager emergency recovery

First run argus-taskmgr-recover.exe in this folder and allow administrator permission. It doesn't depend on the Argus window or the background service.
If that program is damaged too: press Win+R, enter regedit, open it as administrator and go to HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Image File Execution Options\taskmgr.exe. Check that Debugger really points to argus-taskmgr-launcher.exe --task-manager in this folder and that before.debugger in taskmgr-recovery.json is null, then delete only the Debugger value. Don't delete the whole taskmgr.exe key, and don't delete settings of other tools.
The recovery program keeps third-party changes and the recovery record; it stops automatic recovery when no trusted backup exists.
